I’m going to look at other apps and make the switch.  So many complaints with this app but the issues never get fixed

reviews.title: Does not update!
reviews.text:
I used to not have any problems with this app.
But for a couple years now, it takes forever to load the location of my family. I’ll say for example, “12hrs ago” or “2 hrs ago” . I hit the refresh button or live tracking and NOTHING. It’s very annoying. Also sometimes it will go off giving me notifications that one of my contacts is leaving somewhere, (which I have set up) but
BUT they are literally right next to me?? So it def has glitches. I don’t know.. I hate  that if my family is not picking up their phone, I thought I could at least check their location, but it NEVER updates properly!!! 
I’ve tried deleting ands restarting/redownloading. NOTHING
